name: Gaboxadol
summary: Gaboxadol is a depressant substance belonging to the 3-hydroxyisoxazole, 3-Hydroxyisoxazole chemical class.

pharmacology.text: Gaboxadol acts as a potent and selective GABAA receptor partial agonist. In contrast to GABAA receptor positive allosteric modulators like benzodiazepines, Z drugs, barbiturates, and alcohol, gaboxadol is an agonist of the orthosteric site of the GABAA receptor and the same site that the neurotransmitter γ-aminobutyric acid binds to and activates.
pharmacology.kind: GABAA receptor agonist; Sedative; Hypnotic; Central depressant; Hallucinogen

uses.text: Gaboxadol, also known as 4,5,6,7-tetrahydroisoxazolo(5,4-c)pyridin-3-ol (THIP) and by its former developmental code names Lu-2-030, MK-0928, and OV101, is a GABAA receptor agonist related to muscimol which was investigated for the treatment of insomnia and other conditions like Angelman syndrome but was never marketed. It was assessed in clinical studies for various uses in the 1980s, but was not found to be useful.

sideEffects.text: Side effects of gaboxadol include dizziness, sedation, somnolence, headache, nausea, vomiting, and tachycardia, among others. It has also been reported to produce giddiness, depersonalization, impaired concentration, confusion, muscle twitches, and bradycardia. In clinical studies for insomnia, gaboxadol has been found to be generally well-tolerated for up to 12 months. At high doses, it can produce hallucinogenic effects and delirium.

summaryZh: 加波沙朵（英語：Gaboxadol，化學名：4,5,6,7-tetrahydroisoxazolopyridin-3-ol，縮寫THIP）是一種有機化合物，分子式C6H8N2O2，屬於蠅蕈素衍生物類生物鹼，1977由丹麥化學家Poul Krogsgaard-Larsen首次合成。
summaryZhHans: 加波沙朵（英语：Gaboxadol，化学名：4,5,6,7-tetrahydroisoxazolopyridin-3-ol，缩写THIP）是一种有机化合物，分子式C6H8N2O2，属于蝇蕈素衍生物类生物碱，1977由丹麦化学家Poul Krogsgaard-Larsen首次合成。

fact.en: Gaboxadol, first made in 1977 by the Danish chemist Povl Krogsgaard-Larsen, was designed from muscimol, the active compound of the fly agaric mushroom.
fact.zh: 加波沙朵由丹麥化學家 Povl Krogsgaard-Larsen 於 1977 年首次合成，是以毒蠅傘的活性成分蠅蕈醇為藍本設計的。
fact.zhHans: 加波沙朵由丹麦化学家 Povl Krogsgaard-Larsen 于 1977 年首次合成，是以毒蝇伞的活性成分蝇蕈醇为蓝本设计的。
